summary.en: Iwao was found culpable of the robbery by Kogoro who called the police to arrest him but he managed to flee. Tokuro Utsumi remains in an unknown place. After having encountered Conan, he grabs him and threathens to blow him up like tomato juice if they don't let him flee. He then manages to escape via the back door with his Mustang and exits the row of storage hangars. Tokuro had been hired to kill Iwao for less than half of the share. He posted himself in the chimney ready to shoot him through his scope but he missed and lost grip. Having been hired to kill Takatori, Utsumi hid in the chimney ready to shoot Takatori but fell since he lost balance. After Conan had aided Takatori in retrieving the fallen gems inside the chimney, he bound him and drove into the city, where he pushed him out of the car and into the median of a busy street.
